label: visual-only; look values UNMEASURED on the render machine
vendored_note: Nothing was downloaded, vendored or executed. The bake consumes the class map the repo's own core/terrain/landcover.py already produces from ESA WorldCover; no third-party code or asset ships in this lane, and no baked texture is committed (outputs are per scene and carry their own sha256 in land_cover_splat.json).

sources.name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 (via core/terrain/landcover.py; not fetched by this lane)
sources.used_for: the class map the splat is derived from; each bake embeds the scene's landcover.json (crop sha256 and attribution) in its sidecar. Attribution must travel with any distributed splat.

Lekner & Dorf, Why some things are darker when wet, Applied Optics 27(7), 1988
